# Clearer entrate di cassa, Altobelli tab picker, corrected reports, notebook photos — decisions

> Approved on 2026-10-14 at 09:36, round 3 · generated by fluidplan
> Tally: 19 accepted, 0 to change, 0 questions, 0 rejected, 0 without an answer (19 decisions).

## Context

Request (2026-10-14), after the 13/10 consegna:

1. The turnista did not understand that the 32,80 € given back by Altobelli could be entered as an *entra* in "Uscite di cassa". The save error said an *uscita* was missing its motivo, and the close summary still says "Uscite di cassa" for an entrata.
2. The desktop Altobelli page must say it is experimental and let an admin pick which tab of Leonardo's sheet belongs to a consegna (default: the tab with the same date). The 13/10 orders were written in the "6 ottobre" tab.
3. When a consegna is reopened and closed again, the report must highlight what changed since the previous report (today it only adds "(corretto)" to the title).
4. At close, attach one or more photos of the paper notebook where the turnisti do the accounts (a counter-check).

What exists: uscite rows in `public/js/shared/consegna-common.js` (`usciteRowHtml`, badge esce/entra, sign = stored sign), validation in `server/services/validation.js`, report in `server/services/report.js` (`consegne.report_telegram/report_email` hold the last plain-text body), Altobelli in `server/services/altobelli.js` (`trovaSchede` by date, `{ scelte }` when several match), receipt photos in `server/services/scontrini.js` (files under `/app/data/scontrini/<consegna_id>/`, `scontrini.partecipante_id NOT NULL`).

Mockup: `design/mockups/cassa-quaderno.html` (sections A–D = pages A–D here). App strings stay Italian; the plan is in English because fluidplan supports en/fr only. Every UI change ships on mobile **and** desktop (project rule), except the Altobelli page, which is desktop-only.

## Accepted decisions

### A1 · How the direction (out / in) is chosen

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 1 — Entrate/uscite wording, errors and summaries
- **Choice:** Per-row switch "− esce | + entra"
- **Why:** This is what failed on 13/10: the direction is a small badge that reads like a label, defaulting to esce. If the new control is still easy to miss, the next entrata goes in as an uscita and the cassa is off by twice the amount.
- **Proposal:** Each row has a **switch with two short labels, "− esce" and "+ entra"**, both always visible, the active one coloured (red esce, green entra). The "+" adds a row. Typing − or + in the amount still flips the switch.
- **Other options:** Two add links, sign shown on the row (con: Changes the layout people have learned since 2.26.0) · Keep the badge, only rename the block (con: The badge stays easy to overlook, the cause of 13/10)
- **Remarks:** “but badge reads "entra" and "esce"” (round 1)
- **History:** round 1: to change → round 2: accepted → round 3: accepted

### A2 · The words used for the two directions

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 1 — Entrate/uscite wording, errors and summaries
- **Choice:** Uscite di cassa / Entrate di cassa
- **Why:** The same words appear in the block title, the errors, the cassa line, the close summary, the Telegram report and the manuals. Picking them once avoids a second round of renaming everywhere.
- **Proposal:** Block title **"Soldi tolti o rimessi in cassa"**; rows and totals **"Tolti dalla cassa"** (−) and **"Rimessi in cassa"** (+).
- **Other options:** Tolti dalla cassa / Rimessi in cassa (con: Longer labels) · Esce dalla cassa / Entra in cassa (con: Verbs, awkward as totals ("Entra in cassa +32,80"))
- **History:** round 1: accepted → round 2: accepted → round 3: accepted

### A3 · Save errors name the row and its direction

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 1 — Entrate/uscite wording, errors and summaries
- **Why:** On 13/10 the error spoke of an "uscita" while the person was entering an entrata, which made them think the field was the wrong one.
- **Proposal:** The page checks rows before saving and shows, under the rows, e.g. **"Scrivi il motivo dei 32,80 € rimessi in cassa"** or **"Scrivi l'importo di «tofu» tolto dalla cassa"**. The server keeps its own check with the same wording (by sign) as a safety net.
- **History:** round 1: accepted → round 2: accepted → round 3: accepted

### A4 · Totals: two lines instead of one net line

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 1 — Entrate/uscite wording, errors and summaries
- **Choice:** One line per direction
- **Why:** Today one net "Uscite di cassa +32,80" line mixes both directions; with a tolti and a rimessi on the same day the reader cannot tell what happened.
- **Proposal:** Cassa line, close/annulla summary (`consegnaSummaryDetails`) and Telegram/email report show **one line per direction that exists**: "Tolti dalla cassa −20 € (tofu)" and "Rimessi in cassa +32,80 € (storno Altobelli)". The lasciato formula does not change.
- **Other options:** One net line, renamed by its sign (con: A −20 and a +32,80 show as "Rimessi +12,80")
- **History:** round 1: accepted → round 2: accepted → round 3: accepted

### A5 · The "Uscite di cassa" video clip

- **Importance:** Minor
- **Phase:** Phase 5 — Docs and release 2.30.0
- **Why:** `public/video/primo-uscite.mp4` shows today's badge; after A1 it shows a screen that no longer exists.
- **Proposal:** Re-record only that clip (record-full7 chapter `uscite`, cut by clips.py), replace it, bump `data-v` on `/comefunziona`.

### B1 · How "experimental" is shown

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 2 — Altobelli: experimental label and tab picker
- **Why:** Admins may take the comparison as authoritative; it has already missed cases (reused tab, producer credits as negative rows).
- **Proposal:** A **"sperimentale"** badge next to the page title only (the nav item stays "Altobelli"), and one hint line: "Funzione in prova: controlla sempre il risultato sul foglio. Leonardo a volte scrive gli ordini in una scheda vecchia: in quel caso scegli tu la scheda."
- **Remarks:** “no nav item label, only title” (round 1)
- **History:** round 1: to change → round 2: accepted → round 3: accepted

### B2 · Choosing the tab

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 2 — Altobelli: experimental label and tab picker
- **Why:** On 13/10 the date lookup found nothing because the orders were in "6 ottobre"; the page stopped with an error and no way forward.
- **Proposal:** A **"Scheda del foglio"** menu always visible, listing every tab (hidden ones included), newest date first. Default: the tab remembered for this consegna (B3), else the one with the same date, else empty with "Nel foglio non c'è una scheda per il 13 ottobre: scegli la scheda da confrontare".
- **History:** round 1: accepted → round 2: accepted → round 3: accepted

### B3 · Where the chosen tab is remembered

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 2 — Altobelli: experimental label and tab picker
- **Choice:** Not remembered
- **Why:** Without memory the admin re-picks the tab at every visit; the wrong place to store it makes it outlive the consegna or need a migration later.
- **Proposal:** A column **`consegne.altobelli_gid`** (TEXT, null = by date), written when the admin picks a tab different from the date match. It goes away with the consegna.
- **Other options:** Column on consegne (con: Needs the consegna row to exist (it always does when there are conti to compare))
- **History:** round 1: accepted → round 2: accepted → round 3: accepted

### C1 · Layout of the corrected report

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 3 — Report rettifiche on reclose
- **Choice:** Rettifiche on top, then the full report
- **Why:** The report goes to the public Telegram topic, read by people without a GASS account; what they see is the only record they have of the correction.
- **Proposal:** Title as today with "(corretto)", then a block **"Rettifiche rispetto al report del 13/10 ore 21:40:"** with one line per change (value before → value now), then the full report as usual.
- **Other options:** Only the rettifiche and a link (con: People without an account lose the full report) · Full report, changed lines marked ✎ (con: A line listing six people is marked whole when one changes; Old value not visible)
- **History:** round 1: accepted → round 2: accepted → round 3: accepted

### C2 · How GASS knows what changed

- **Importance:** Critical
- **Phase:** Phase 3 — Report rettifiche on reclose
- **Choice:** JSON snapshot column
- **Why:** This decides the stored data. A text diff of the old message cannot tell which person in a line changed; a structured copy can, but adds a column whose shape must stay readable by later versions.
- **Proposal:** When a report is sent, store a **JSON snapshot** of what it showed in `consegne.report_dati`: per person {conto, versato, teatro}, the uscite rows, trovato, pagato, lasciato, sent time. The next report compares the current data with it.
- **Other options:** Line diff of the stored text (con: Changes only at line level; wording changes (A2) look like rettifiche)
- **History:** round 1: accepted → round 2: accepted → round 3: accepted

### C3 · What counts as a rettifica

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 3 — Report rettifiche on reclose
- **Why:** Too little and a correction goes unnoticed; too much and the block repeats the whole report.
- **Proposal:** Lines for: a person added or removed; per person **conto produttore**, **versato** and **quota teatro** ("Marco B: conto produttore 0 → 23,50"); tolti/rimessi rows added, removed or changed; **trovato**, **pagato al produttore** and **lasciato in cassa** when they change. Not listed: credit/debt splits (they follow from conto and versato) and the day's note.
- **History:** round 1: accepted → round 2: accepted → round 3: accepted

### D1 · Where notebook photos are stored

- **Importance:** Critical
- **Phase:** Phase 4 — Notebook photos at close
- **Choice:** New table, same folder
- **Why:** `scontrini.partecipante_id` is NOT NULL and SQLite cannot drop that without rebuilding the table; the choice decides whether a production table is rebuilt.
- **Proposal:** A new table **`quaderno_foto`** (id, consegna_id → consegne CASCADE, file, larghezza, altezza, byte, created_by, created_at). Files go in the same folder as the receipts, `/app/data/scontrini/<consegna_id>/`, so deleting a consegna and the deploy tar already cover them.
- **Other options:** Rebuild scontrini with a nullable person and a type (con: Table rebuild migration in production; Every scontrini query must handle "no person")
- **History:** round 1: accepted → round 2: accepted → round 3: accepted

### D2 · Where the photos are taken

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 4 — Notebook photos at close
- **Choice:** Block under the cassa, proposed by the close dialog
- **Why:** Taking a photo can make the phone drop the page: on 13/10 someone had to save the movimento first and add the receipt photo afterwards, because the page reloaded on the way back from the camera. A photo button inside the close dialog would lose the dialog the same way, so the upload must live where a reload costs nothing.
- **Proposal:** A **"Quaderno" block under the cassa** (mobile and desktop), usable any time while the consegna is open: Fotografa on touch, drag and drop with a mouse, upload at once, thumbnails open the lightbox. The **close dialog proposes it**: it shows "Foto del quaderno: 2" or, with none, "Non hai fotografato il quaderno" and a button **"Fotografa prima"** that cancels the dialog and scrolls to the block. The photo stays optional.
- **Other options:** Upload both in the close dialog and under the cassa (con: If the phone reloads the page, the dialog and its state are lost) · Only under the cassa, no mention at close (con: Easy to forget before closing)
- **Remarks:** “Adding photo can be problematic: a user yeesterday had to save movimento then edit it to add photo bcause when adding foto page would relaod. So adding quaderno photo should be allowed and maybe proposed outside of chiudi consegna though that's the right moment to do it” (round 1); “do a mockup” (round 2)
- **History:** round 1: to change → round 2: to change → round 3: accepted

### D7 · Unsaved fields survive a page reload, across the app

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 4 — Notebook photos at close
- **Choice:** Keep unsaved fields in every form and restore them
- **Why:** On 13/10 a turnista lost a half-filled card when the page reloaded after taking a receipt photo. Any form can be lost the same way (camera, phone call, the phone dropping a background tab), so one shared mechanism is cheaper than fixing each form when it bites.
- **Proposal:** One shared helper, **`public/js/shared/bozze.js`**: every form keeps what is typed in `sessionStorage` while it is not saved, and a page that loads again puts it back with a toast "Ho ripreso quello che avevi scritto e non era salvato". Saving or cancelling the form clears it. Password fields are never stored. Applies to: the consegna card (mobile and desktop, reopened on the same person), note and tolti/rimessi, Saldi "Modifica saldo" and "Modifica utente" / new participant (desktop), the teatro corrections, the turni notes, the Altobelli link.
- **Other options:** Save the card automatically before opening the camera (con: Saves half-typed amounts; Fails if the card is not valid yet) · Not in this release (con: Same problem next Tuesday)
- **Remarks:** “"unsaved fields are kept in sessionStorage" this should always be, across the app” (round 2)
- **History:** round 2: to change → round 3: accepted

## Glossary

- **entra** (entrata, entrate) — An uscita with a negative amount: money put back into the cassa, e.g. the 32,80 € Altobelli returned on 13/10.
- **gid** — The numeric id of one tab of a Google sheet; GASS downloads a tab as CSV by its gid, hidden tabs included.
- **rettifica** (rettifiche) — Here: a value that changed between the report sent at the first close and the one sent after a reopen and reclose.
- **snapshot** — A JSON copy of the numbers a report showed, stored when the report is sent, so the next report can be compared field by field.
- **uscita** (uscite, uscite di cassa) — A row of `uscite_cassa`: cash taken out of (stored positive) or put back into (stored negative) the consegna's cassa, with a motivo.
